_note: The usual first job that builds experience toward each role. Used when the gap is years of work experience, which a study plan can't close.

roles.Software Engineer: a junior software developer job or a software engineering internship
roles.AI/ML Engineer: a junior data scientist, data analyst or software engineer job, or a machine learning internship
roles.Data Scientist: a data analyst or junior data scientist job
roles.Security Engineer: a SOC analyst (Tier 1), IT support or junior security analyst job
roles.Computer Engineer: an embedded or firmware internship, or a hardware test technician job
roles.IT Support Specialist: a help desk or IT support technician job
roles.Hardware Engineer: a hardware test technician job or a hardware engineering internship
roles.QA Engineer: a QA tester or manual QA analyst job
roles.Product Manager: an associate product manager, product analyst or business analyst job
